visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair and a hair clip, wearing a white cardigan over a black low-cut top, sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit interior. She holds a smartphone in her right hand, looking down at the screen and then moving her mouth as if speaking toward someone off-camera. A glass teapot and a dish of tea leaves are placed on the table in front of her. (2) The scene cuts to a man wearing a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black button-down shirt. He is leaning back in a chair with his head tilted completely towards the ceiling, his mouth slightly open and eyes directed upwards. He remains in this static, unusual position while moving his lips, with wooden walls and blinds in the background. (3) The woman is shown again, now exhibiting a furrowed brow and a frowning expression. She raises her left hand near her hair, gesturing emphatically while her mouth moves in an expressive manner. The lighting is warm and natural, emphasizing her frustrated facial features and gestures. (4) The shot transitions to a direct top-down, overhead view of the woman looking straight up into the camera lens. She holds a small, clear glass of tea in her right hand. The surrounding background is dark and circular, creating a focused, stylistic contrast with the earlier rectangular wooden table setting.
